messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: GPU provisioning failures observed in us-east1 causing autoscaler to stall. Queue size increasing for inference route /v1/generate. Severity: P1. Paging on-call.

alex: saw the alert. getting logs now. queue length at 08:02 UTC jumped from ~120 -> 780 in 5m.

emily: confirming — customer-facing errors starting ~08:01, 429s and 503s. latency noisy for smaller requests too.

raj: autoscaler logs show repeated API errors from GCP quota API: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_V100' exceeded for project". requests to create instances returning 403.

maria: trying manual scale won't work if quota is at limit. any spare capacity in other regions?

jordan: eu-west1 has free capacity but cross-region latency may break SLAs for some customers. can we failover lower-priority traffic?

ops-bot: Added incident channel banner and set statuspage to partial outage for inference-hosted-us-east1. Ticket created: INC-2026-1843.

alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply priority queuing to preserve enterprise routes 2) divert best-effort embeddings and low-tier requests to cpu-backend (smaller model) 3) attempt quota increase with cloud support and request expedited review.

emily: implementing priority queuing now. will respond to low-priority with 429 and Retry-After header to protect critical requests.

maria: configuring cpu-backend routing rule in the router. note: responses will be lower quality — need comms for affected customers.

raj: tried to request quota via GCP console but project limit is hard-capped by org policy. contacting GCP TAM, opening support case with escalation. ticket: 1234567890 (submitted).

cloud-support-bot: GCP case 1234567890 acknowledged. ETA for quota review: up to 4 hours unless expedited. Recommended short-term: use alternative regions or reserved capacity.

jordan: reserved capacity won't spin up fast. We have a small pool in us-west2 with compatible models. can we live-route some traffic there?

alex: yes — but need to adjust model selection to compatible quantized variant. pushing config change to Router with canary 10% -> 50% if stable.

ops-bot: Deploy started: router-config v2026.3.2 -> canary 10% for us-west2 fallback and cpu-backend for low tier.

emily: logs after routing changes: queue for critical routes stabilized at ~60, but overall queue still high because bulk of free-tier requests keep retrying.

maria: adding token bucket rate limit for free-tier: 1 request/sec per org with 30 burst. will cut down churn.

raj: temporary workaround: enable model-quantization fallback for some large models. setting model flag: fallback_to_int8=true for non-enterprise routes.

alex: here's the command I ran on the router (for record):
```
# route non-enterprise to cpu-backend
redwoodctl route update --match "tier==free" --backend cpu-backend --rate-limit 1/s --retry-after 30
# canary to us-west2
redwoodctl route update --match "tier==enterprise" --backend us-west2-quantized --canary 0.1
```

jordan: monitoring metrics: p95 latency for enterprise is back to SLO. error-rate for free-tier remains ~18% but trending down since rate-limits.

product-ops: need statement for customers — drafting notification: "Partial degradation in US East for non-enterprise inference; enterprise traffic preserved. We're routing to alternate capacity and working with cloud provider on quota increase."

emily: customer-impact summary for incident record: ~7% of total requests experienced 5xx/429 between 08:01 - 09:05 UTC. Major enterprise customers unaffected due to priority queuing; some mid-market customers saw increased latency.

raj: GCP just responded on case 1234567890: they can provision additional quota for us if we provide planned usage and a billing account owner confirms. asked finance to approve immediate uplift.

ops-bot: finance notified via pager. awaiting approval.

alex: long-term actions (postmortem items): 1) request higher baseline GPU quotas in us-east1 2) implement cross-region warm pools and runbook for transparent routing 3) add autoscaler retry/backoff on quota errors with exponential backoff and circuit-breaker to stop thrashing 4) better per-tenant throttling to avoid noisy neighbors.

maria: captured logs and traces to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/1812345600/ for postmortem analysis.

cloud-support-bot: GCP case updated: initial uplift approved conditional on billing-confirmation. next ETA 1h after confirmation.

alex: finance confirmed and approved billing rep. raj — confirm with GCP we'll get quota uplift and provide go/no-go timeframe?

raj: GCP replied: immediate temporary uplift of 20 GPUs granted to project within ~30m. permanent increase requires org-level request. I'll follow-up.

emily: observing gradual draining of queue. error-rate down to 4% at 09:15 UTC.

jordan: starting handoff to night oncall in 30m. @alex can you create concise handoff note? include current mitigations and outstanding actions.

alex: handoff note: "Mitigations active: priority queuing for enterprise, cpu-backend for free-tier, rate-limits applied to free-tier, canary routing to us-west2 quantized instances. GCP temporary +20 GPU uplift requested, ETA ~30m. Outstanding: permanent quota increase, warm pool runbook, autoscaler backoff logic. Contact: raj (cloud escalation), emily (metrics)."

product-ops: statuspage update posted: "Partial service degradation in US East affecting non-paid tiers. Enterprise traffic prioritized. Full resolution pending cloud quota increase."

ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 09:20 UTC after mitigations held and queue draining.

alex: closing note before handoff: we'll keep monitoring. if quota uplift doesn't arrive by 09:50 UTC, re-open escalations with GCP TAM and consider migrating some paid customers to us-west2 permanently until quotas are stable.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. Next oncall: emily-night (starts 09:30 UTC). Thread pinned to incidents channel.
